reviews.title: Pretty average, don't pay full price for it
reviews.review_text: I was looking for an inexpensive radio to play for my cat while I was at work. I paid $30 for this radio, which I think is fair. The original price of $50 is definitely too high for what you get. The plastic on the radio is pretty cheap. It was easy to connect the bluetooth and the cd player works well, but there is no way of knowing what radio station is playing. Also it says you have to take out the batteries before connecting the ac adaptor, which I thought was kind of weird. Overall, this radio is just pretty average.
